Your instructor

Harsh Snehanshu

Writer · Founder · Community builder

Harsh Snehanshu is a writer, entrepreneur and a serial community-builder.

He graduated from IIT Delhi with a degree in Engineering Physics, is a Young India Fellow, and studied urban policy at Sciences Po in Paris.

He co-founded YourQuote, a YC-backed writing app with over 8 million users, and co-founded and Bookmark, a dating app for readers.

He also co-founded Pint of View, India’s largest lecture community, Cubbon Reads, the world’s largest silent reading community, with chapters in 130 cities across four continents.

He’s currently organising Asia’s first-ever Lecture FestivalTM, a festival of learning over drinks on 19–20 December 2026 at Jayamahal Palace Grounds, Bengaluru.

Through his work building communities, he shares practical frameworks, learnings, and playbooks for finding people who care, giving them reasons to return, and taking a community from its first idea to its first event.
